property_summary: When addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue is called, the paused() function should return the same value before and after the call.
After any successful call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the paused() function must return false.
Before and after calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, paused() returns the same value.

The returned value of paused() must equal the negation of the internal _paused state, which is not directly visible; however, the bug changes the return value of paused() from true to false (or vice versa) for the same internal state. Since _paused is initially false, paused() should return false. After an unpause() call, _paused becomes true, so paused() should return true. The bug makes paused() return the opposite. So the invariant is: after unpausing, paused() must return true; after pausing again, paused() must return false. The bug breaks this: after unpausing, paused() returns false.
When contract is paused, calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue reverts.
The value of lrtConfig remains unchanged after any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue.
After any sequence of calls ending with addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig address remains the same as it was before the first call.
After any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the getter updateLRTConfig() returns address that is not zero.
After any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig address remains unchanged from the initial value set during initialize.
After addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue completes, the lrtConfig address stays the same as the initial lrtConfig address set in initialize.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig state variable's address is non-zero.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig state variable's address equals the address passed to the most recent call to updateLRTConfig.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the lrtConfig address is the same as the address last passed to updateLRTConfig.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the nodeDelegatorQueue includes all addresses passed in the input array.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with a non-empty array, the lrtConfig address stored in the contract is non-zero (i.e., not the null address).
After any sequence of addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue calls, the maxNodeDelegatorCount state variable must be at least the length of nodeDelegatorQueue.

After any sequence of transactions ending with updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount, the maxNodeDelegatorCount state variable must equal the argument passed to the most recent updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount call.

After any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the maxNodeDelegatorCount must be equal to its initial value (10) plus any updates via updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount; the property focuses on the fact that updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount actually updates the state.

After executing addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the maxNodeDelegatorCount stored in state must be either 10 (default) or the last value set by an updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount call, never a stale value because the update was skipped.
After any call to updateMaxNodeDelegatorCount with a valid non-zero argument, the state variable maxNodeDelegatorCount must equal that argument.
After adding a new node delegator contract, the length of nodeDelegatorQueue never exceeds maxNodeDelegatorCount.
After adding a new node delegator contract, the length of nodeDelegatorQueue is at most maxNodeDelegatorCount.
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with an array of length 1, the value of maxNodeDelegatorCount is updated to a new value (the new value is returned by the public getter).
After calling addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue with the same array length, the number of node delegators (nodeDelegatorQueue.length) does not decrease.
After adding node delegators, the queue length never exceeds maxNodeDelegatorCount, and the returned queue length matches the stored length.
After any sequence of public calls ending with addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the sum of lengths of the nodeDelegatorQueue after and before the call equals the number of addresses passed.

After any sequence of public calls ending with addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the number of nodes added (increase in nodeDelegatorQueue length) must be at most maxNodeDelegatorCount minus the initial length, because maxNodeDelegatorCount is initialized to 10 in the reference.
After any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the length of nodeDelegatorQueue never exceeds 10.
After any sequence of calls ending with addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue, the length of nodeDelegatorQueue never exceeds maxNodeDelegatorCount.
When no call to setMaxNodeDelegatorCount has been made, the nodeDelegatorQueue length never exceeds 10 after any call to addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue.
The maximum node delegator count must be non-zero to allow adding node delegator contracts.
After adding a node delegator contract, the nodeDelegatorQueue length must be greater than zero.
After adding node delegator contracts, the queue length should be at least the number of contracts added if the initial count is non-zero.
After successfully adding a node delegator contract, the nodeDelegatorQueue length must be greater than zero.
If the maximum node delegator count is zero, then addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue always reverts.
getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) returns at least assetLyingInDepositPool + assetLyingInNDCs (i.e., the sum of the first two components from getAssetDistributionData).
addNodeDelegatorContractToQueue can be called any number of times without affecting the total asset deposits computed for any supported asset

getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) returns a value that is at least as large as assetLyingInDepositPool + assetLyingInNDCs (the sum of the first two components from getAssetDistributionData), independent of the node delegator queue.
getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) returns the sum of all three components from getAssetDistributionData.
The total asset deposits for any supported asset should not be less than the amount lying in the deposit pool plus the amount held by node delegators.
getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) always returns at least assetLyingInDepositPool
getTotalAssetDeposits returns the sum of asset lying in deposit pool, NDCs, and staked in EigenLayer; it should be at least as large as any individual component.
getTotalAssetDeposits returns a non-decreasing function as nodeDelegatorQueue length increases, assuming the asset is supported and NodeDelegator balances are non-negative.
getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) is always >= assetLyingInDepositPool, because it sums all components.

For a supported asset, getTotalAssetDeposits(asset) should increase or stay the same when a new node delegator contract is added to the queue, given the node delegator has a non-zero balance of the asset.
